title: Add NFT collections to Werkverzeichnis with preview images and Getgems links

requirements.text: Update NFTCollectionsSection.tsx to include all seven NFT collections with their exact Getgems URLs: Lichtei (https://getgems.io/lichtei), Wheel of Time (https://getgems.io/wheeloftime), Colour Shades (https://getgems.io/colourshades), Schieferlichtgrafik (https://getgems.io/collection/EQCgrHXOmAryUksLLtlh5dsXyT_h2DF6vLiEUiwsj05KFjJM), Light Seekers (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA1W-YI6IGmi_94KoIgwgD79i_bhz0Uot-Z1y5W8fBGuIAz), Panel Paintings (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA_bfpwKniQOAATWojdfIDk9X7_mCW_Stpzt_1kDSF6UDYV), and Flammenbilder Fire Dance (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA8b4VisUmrk2tiumRI-wmlM3QhahoGeGNqSYzrO6s9O2Vf). Each card must link directly to its Getgems collection URL (opening in a new tab) and display a dedicated preview image from frontend/public/assets/generated.

quotes: Schieferlichtgrafik: https://getgems.io/collection/EQCgrHXOmAryUksLLtlh5dsXyT_h2DF6vLiEUiwsj05KFjJM, light seekers: https://getgems.io/collection/EQA1W-YI6IGmi_94KoIgwgD79i_bhz0Uot-Z1y5W8fBGuIAz, panel paintings: https://getgems.io/collection/EQA_bfpwKniQOAATWojdfIDk9X7_mCW_Stpzt_1kDSF6UDYV und Flammenbilder fire dance: https://getgems.io/collection/EQA8b4VisUmrk2tiumRI-wmlM3QhahoGeGNqSYzrO6s9O2Vf

acceptanceCriteria: All seven collection cards are visible in the NFT collections section
Each card shows the correct collection name and a unique preview image
Clicking a card opens the exact Getgems URL for that collection in a new browser tab
No collection is missing or has a wrong URL
Preview images are loaded from frontend/public/assets/generated

constraints: Do not change the Getgems URLs — use them exactly as provided by the user
Do not route generated preview images through the backend
nonGoals: Adding new backend data models or admin CRUD for these static collections
Fetching live NFT data from the Getgems API
Changing the overall layout or design of the NFTCollectionsSection beyond updating collection data and images
